S0_bare_minimum.description: associate: first name + surname; relative: first name only (surname assumed shared); residence: county name only, no word 'county', no state

S1_relative_surname.description: as S0 but the relative also gets a surname (a married sister or a mother would need one)

S2_county_word.description: as S1 plus the word 'county' (6 letters) after each county name, as B2 writes 'county of bedford'

S3_county_and_state.description: as S2 plus 'virginia' (8 letters) for each residence

S4_initials_only.description: extreme abbreviation: associate = initial + surname; relative = initial + surname; residence = county name

S5_initials_no_relative_surname.description: associate = initial + surname; relative = first name only; residence = county name

S6_surnames_and_counties_only.description: floor: associate surname + relative surname + county name, nothing else
